lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gills, exhibiting a semi-regular grid distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating anchor nodes in a rectangular grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal aspect and shadow on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Multiple high-luminance blobs distributed across the first dorsal fin silhouette, with a prominent spot located near the posterior-superior margin and several smaller clusters toward the base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, circular region of reddish-orange pigment is visible on the upper flank, dorsal to the intersection of the second and third gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots distinct from the larger lateral flank patterning.
